card.name: Start of a name or drug before its next piece
card.fires_on: The first piece of a name or drug term when more letters must follow, such as 'mar' before 'aviroc', 'Te' before 'pper', or 'Bar' before 'bour'. Also a lone initial letter like 'E.' in a reviewer name.

modes.label: Drug name start
modes.description: The 'mar' that begins maraviroc in a list of antiretroviral drugs.

modes.label: Surname start
modes.description: The first piece of a person's surname that is split across several pieces.
modes.example: says Alan<< Bar>>bour of the University of California, Irvine

modes.label: Lone initial
modes.description: A single capital letter that begins a name or title.
modes.example: |Primary Medical Reviewer||<<E>>. Gregory Thompson, MD - Internal Medicine

card.writes: It boosts word starts like 'rip', 'ri' and 'rib', and suppresses odd foreign or broken tokens.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of an unusual name or drug, such as the 'mar' of maraviroc, when the rest is still to come.
